questions.prompt: Effective stacks are 22bb. Folded to the button, you have AJo. A fitting plan is…

choices.text: Raise all-in, or raise an amount you are willing to call.
Limp and fold to a jam
Fold. AJo is an under-the-gun hand only

questions.explanation: At this depth the button does not have a long postflop tree.

questions.prompt: Effective stacks are 40bb. You have 76s under the gun. Best default?

choices.text: Fold. You are early, short, and the hand needs depth and position.

questions.explanation: Speculative hands from early position get worse as stacks shrink.

questions.prompt: You have top pair, good kicker, on a dry flop, and the pot already holds a third of your 30bb stack. Best default?

choices.text: Commit. There is not enough stack left to find a fold with this hand.
Fold top pair because the stack is short

questions.explanation: Low stack-to-pot ratio means good one pair is a get-in hand on a safe board.

questions.prompt: A short stack jams 20bb over your open and you cover them with 200bb. Your extra chips…

choices.text: Do not matter. You can only win the 20bb.
Change the jam into a 200bb decision

questions.explanation: Effective stack is the smaller stack in the pot.
